subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------T.C.IMP.------INF.AFB.
description: First of three diagrams on page 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12) — a triple-crossing that diagrams how multi-information meets time-continuum-implications meets information affinity basis in the structural form of cultural-information regulation. (C)MT-INFO (the concept of multi-information) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) which is in turn crossed with INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). MT-INFO sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TH-CONT-DYM (thrust continuance dynamics) hangs below from the stretch between MT-INFO and T-C-IMP. T-C-IMP is the middle axis; PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) drops below T-C-IMP as the bridging-axis downward output, with EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) connected to T-C-IMP by a *dashed* line that amplifies some aspect of T-C-IMP. INFO-AF-B sits at upper-right as partner-axis terminus. Structural argument: the triple-axis shows the three-step route by which multi-information actually reaches information-affinity-basis — multi-information routes through time-continuum-implications which routes through information-affinity-basis.
